subject: make-paper-poster SVG output
purpose: Produce one high-signal prose critique of the poster's aesthetic quality, visual communication, and paper fidelity for the outer agent's next mutation. The evaluator must not assign numeric quality scores.
feedback_policy: Visual quality and paper fidelity are advisory natural-language mutation signals for the outer agent; they do not affect binary reward.
review_focus: authored visual language: deliberate palette, effects, and paper-specific visual identity rather than generic AI-template styling
readability and hierarchy: legible typography, contrast, focal point, and a clear path from problem to method to evidence to takeaway
layout and geometry: spacing, alignment, balance, density, clipping, occlusion, and canvas use
paper-specific visualization: whether the method, mechanism, comparison, or result is communicated visually rather than merely decorated
paper fidelity: whether the visual story preserves the source paper's meaning without invented claims or evidence
response_requirements: Return one plain-text feedback message, not separate criterion fields.
Name the strongest successful choices before prioritizing the biggest weaknesses.
Give concrete, high-leverage revision directions grounded in the rendered poster and the source paper.
Do not emit numeric scores, rankings, or a pass/fail verdict.

svg_geometry_check.interpretation: The bundled stdlib-only checker reports text and node overflow as errors, while overlap and occlusion are review cues because intentional foreground/background overlaps can be valid.

contrast_check.status: recommended evaluator check; implementation may be added later
requirements: Body text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1.
Large title text contrast ratio is at least 3:1.
Report the text, foreground, background, and measured ratio.

hard_gates.description: The deliverable is valid SVG, renders successfully, and does not depend on external URLs, scripts, fonts, or raster assets that can disappear.
No text or non-text geometry extends outside the SVG viewBox. Overlap and occlusion warnings remain advisory review cues because intentional foreground/background overlap can be valid.
